blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Weight Factorization (WF) methods aim to reduce a model's latency, memory, or both. These typically decompose a pretrained model into two or more factors that approximate the original model weights with fewer parameters and floating point operations (FLOPs). However, translating fewer FLOPs into reduced latency is challenging for WF methods in practice due to overhead introduced by replacing a single large weight matrix with multiple smaller ones. To address this, we propose Balanced Twin Weight Factorization (BTWF), which uses the unique structure of factorized models to simultaneously lower latency and increase learning capacity. Specifically, BTWF operates in the shared basis WF setting, where two or more layers are decomposed into a shared basis matrix and a layer-specific mixing matrix. If these shared layers have the same input (i.e., are twins), then we need only perform this shared forward pass once, reducing inference time. However, twin layers are often of varying sizes, and methods from prior work tend to favor the larger layer. In contrast, our approach boosts performance by combining Factor Component Balancing (FCB), which ensures every shared member is well represented in the selected factors, with Block Contribution Balancing (BCB), which considers downstream model effects. Further, we also show that an overparameterized BTWF, where some layer's factors result in higher FLOPs than the original during training, can boost task performance without additional resources at test time. Experiments on six models over nine benchmarks show BTWF obtains a 2-6% gain over the state-of-the-art without expensive finetuning (1-3.5% gain with it) at comparable computational costs.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Weight Factorization (WF) methods reduce a model’s latency and memory by decomposing a large weight matrix into two or more smaller ones [ 76 , 75 , 96 , 94 , 95 , 84 , 9 , 105 , 102 , 57 ] .
However, the latency drop realized by these methods is less than their reduction in the number of floating-point operations (FLOPs) due to the overhead required to launch a sequence of small matrix multiplications. In fact, many optimization methods explicitly avoid this additional cost by reducing the number of matrix multiplications in a forward pass ( e.g . , by fusing key-query-value attention) [ 77 , 2 ] . Prior work addresses this by creating a shared basis factor between twin layers that see the same input and, thus, a shared basis need only be computed once [ 3 , 63 ] . Then, unshared mixing factors capture layer-specific information. However, as illustrated in Fig. 1 (a), when shared layers are of unequal sizes ( e.g . , GQA [ 1 ] , MQA [ 86 ] , and MLA [ 19 ] attention as well as gate and up projections of a SwiGLU MLP [ 87 ] ), their simple concatenation then decomposition results in favoring larger layers.
blocks.zh:
重量因数化方法将一个大的重量矩阵分解成两个或两个以上较小的矩阵,从而降低模型的耐久性和内存[76、75、96、94、95、84、9、105、102、57]。
然而,这些方法实现的暂时性下降还不如它们减少浮动点操作(FLOPs)的数量,因为发射一系列小矩阵乘法需要高通量. 事实上,许多优化方法都通过减少前传中矩阵乘法的数量(例如,将键-query-value 注意力放出)[77,2]明确避免了这种额外费用. 以前的工作解决了这一问题,在看到相同投入的双层之间创造了一个共同的基础系数,因此,一个共同的基础只需要计算一次[3,63]。 然后,不共享的混合因子捕捉到分层特定信息. 然而,如图1(a)所示,当共享层的大小不均(例如,GQA[1]、MQA[86]和MLA[19]注意以及SwiGLU MLP的大门和上升预测)时,它们的简单调和会有利于更大的层。

blocks.en: This paper directly addresses these practical limitations via our Balanced Twin Weight Factorization (BTWF) approach. Specifically, as shown in Fig. 1 (b), when selecting what factors to keep we introduce two benefits over prior WF work [ 102 , 3 , 63 ] . First, Factor Component Balancing (FCB) ensures each twin member is well represented by scaling shared basis members by their Frobenius norms before decomposition. This helps address a bias in prior work towards selecting factors that benefit larger members more than smaller ones. Second, we propose Block Contribution Balancing (BCB), which weights factors by their contribution to block-level output error. This helps us retain factors that may not contribute as much to reconstructing the original model’s weights, but can help keep information more useful for future layers.
blocks.zh: 本文件通过我们的平衡双重因子化办法直接述及这些实际限制。 具体地说,如图1(b)所示,在选择保留哪些因素时,我们比WF以前的工作带来两个好处[102、3、63]。 首先,要素要素平衡(FCB)确保每个双成员在分解前都能通过Frobenius规范对共享基础成员进行分级,从而得到充分代表。 这有助于解决先前工作中对选择使较大成员比较小成员受益的因素的偏见。 第二,我们提议 " 块贡献平衡 " (BCB),它通过因素在 " 块级 " 输出误差中的贡献来权衡这些因素。 这有助于我们保留那些对重建原始模型的权重可能没有多大帮助的因素,但有助于保持信息对未来各层更加有用。

blocks.en: Despite the more effective factors provided by BTWF, our experiments still show that some layers rapidly degrade performance as their rank shrinks. This echoes similar observations in related work that highlighted unequal effects from removing similar weight counts for different layers [ 76 , 96 , 58 , 110 , 71 , 17 , 113 , 52 ] . To address this, we show that BTWF can also be used to create Overparameterized Groups (OG) on these low-rank sensitive layers that use more total parameters than the layers they are sourced from, effectively increasing model capacity instead of reducing it. At inference time these OG factors are baked back to the original layer size ( i.e . , they require no more resources than the original model after training). Thus, this shows our single framework can simultaneously be used to reduce latency and boost task performance. See Fig. 2 for an example of how BTWF is used. Experiments on six models of various sizes and families evaluated on nine diverse benchmarks on image-language and video-language tasks show that BTWF outperforms the state-of-the-art when controlling for FLOPs, latency, and memory.
blocks.zh: 尽管BTWF提供了更有效的因素,但我们的实验仍然显示,有些地层随着分级收缩而迅速降解性能. 这与相关工作中的类似意见相呼应,这些意见强调了消除不同层的类似加权数所产生的不平等影响[76、96、58、110、71、17、113、52]。 为了解决这个问题,我们表明,BTWF还可以用来在这些低等敏感地层上创建超参数化组(OG),比出自地层的地层使用更多的总参数,有效地提高模型容量而不是降低. 推断出这些OG因子被烤回原地层大小(即训练后不需要再多的资源了). 因此,这表明我们的单一框架可以同时用于减少延迟并提升任务绩效。 见法相. 2,作为如何使用BTWF的例子. 在图像语言和视频语言任务9个不同基准上评价的6个不同大小和家庭模型的实验表明,BTWF在控制FLOP,耐用和内存时的成绩超过了最先进的.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are: • We propose BTWF, a shared WF approach that uses FCB to minimize the bias favoring larger layers suffered by prior work, resulting in gains of 2-6% without expensive finetuning and 1-3.5% with it. • We show that we can more effectively reconstruct layer weights thanks to BCB, which helps retain more informative factors by considering the effect on its block output. • We demonstrate BTWF’s ability to serve as a drop-in replacement for methods that compose with weight pruning, token pruning, and quantization for further gains.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,我们的贡献是: 我们提议采用共同的WF方法,即利用FCB来尽量减少偏好以前工作所经历的更上一层的偏好,从而在不进行昂贵的微调的情况下,实现2-6%的收益和1-3.5%的收益。 我们显示,由于BCB,我们可以更有效地重建地层重量,它有助于通过考虑对其块输出的影响来保留更多的信息性因素。 我们展示出BTWF有能力作为替代方法的倒计时替代,这些方法由重量计分、象征性计分和量化组成,以获得更多收益。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Shared WF methods are closest to ours, where prior work did not account for the varying layer sizes in their reconstruction [ 3 , 63 , 102 ] , forwent the inference benefits of twin layers discussed earlier by sharing only a portion of the basis factor [ 46 , 67 ] , or trained from scratch instead of adapting pretrained models [ 76 , 96 , 119 , 118 , 19 , 34 ] . There are also some WF methods that focused on other tasks like model compression [ 105 , 102 , 76 , 96 , 120 , 104 , 57 ] , continual learning [ 94 , 95 ] , or reducing training time [ 75 ] . However, these methods did not reduce latency and/or considered how retained factors contribute on its block output.
blocks.zh: 共享的WF方法最接近我们,以前的工作没有考虑到重建中不同的地层大小[3,63,102],完全没有通过共享部分基础系数[46,67],或者从零开始训练,而不是调整预先训练的模型[76,96,119,118,19,34]来说明先前讨论的双层推论的好处. 还有一些WF方法侧重于模型压缩等其它任务[105,102,76,96,120,104,57],持续学习[94,95],或缩短培训时间[75]. 然而,这些方法并没有减少延迟和/或考虑所保留的因素如何对其块产出作出贡献。

blocks.en: Related tasks that reduce a model’s memory and latency include weight pruning [ 53 , 38 , 56 , 70 , 97 , 52 , 26 , 64 , 91 , 4 , 92 , 66 , 71 , 113 , 33 , 78 , 58 , 110 , 122 , 107 , 65 , 93 , 112 , 17 , 22 , 55 , 69 , 49 , 68 , 100 , 117 , 23 , 8 , 88 ] , attention compression [ 68 , 100 , 58 , 64 , 4 , 33 , 71 , 17 , 113 ] , model quantization [ 61 , 27 , 114 , 20 , 45 , 81 , 37 , 108 , 16 ] , or knowledge distillation [ 32 , 98 , 48 , 83 , 121 , 40 ] . However, prior work has shown WF methods can be combined with these tasks for additional gains [ 3 , 63 , 95 , 76 , 12 ] . We will show BTWF can be used as a drop-in replacement to boost performance further.

Token pruning [ 101 , 116 , 59 , 80 , 50 , 11 , 13 ] and mixture-of-experts [ 18 , 47 , 126 , 82 , 123 , 21 , 24 , 54 , 85 ] are examples of tasks that focus on reducing inference time rather than memory (ours reduces both). Prior work has shown they can also be combined with methods like BTWF for an additional boost [ 107 ] . As with the weight pruning and quantization methods, our experiments report gains from using BTWF as drop-in replacement in this setting too.
blocks.zh: Token pruning [101, 116, 59, 80, 50, 11, 13] 和混合专家[18, 47, 126, 82, 123, 21, 24, 54, 85] 是注重减少推论时间而不是记忆的任务的例子(我们两者都减少了). 先前的研究表明,它们也可以与BTWF等方法相结合,以进一步提振[107]。 与重量计算和量化方法一样,我们的实验报告也从使用BTWF作为在此情况下的倒置替代而受益。

blocks.en: 4.1 Results
blocks.zh: 4.1 结果

blocks.en: Tab. 1 reports criteria-only weight pruning/WF to fit a FLOPs budget, where every layer in the network is reduced the same amount and only vary on what is retained. BTWF gets a 2-3% overall boost over prior work, with gains on both Seen and Unseen datasets. Comparing the last three lines of Tab. 1 , we find that both FCB ( Sec. 3.1 ) and BCB ( Sec. 3.2 ) contribute to their overall performance, with their combinations becoming more effective as FLOPs decrease. These results help highlight how effective the weight reduction criteria itself is. Further, this setting’s uniform shapes suit graph compilers such as XLA in JAX [ 28 ] , NVIDIA’s TensorRT [ 73 ] , and torch.compile [ 5 ] , which specialize kernels to static shapes, enabling sharing across identical blocks. However, many methods in prior work perform very poorly, in part, due to the uniform reduction strategy. In fact, many prior work’s (often non-uniform) budget allocation strategy is sometimes listed as a primary contribution ( e.g . , [ 4 , 100 , 65 , 57 , 102 , 63 , 113 ] ).
blocks.zh: Tab. 1 报告只使用标准重量的推算/WF以适应FLOPs的预算,其中网络中的每一层都减少同样的数量,并且只保留哪些内容。 与以前的工作相比,BTWF的总体提振率为2-3%,在Seen和Sunsen数据集上都取得了收益。 比较最后三行的Tab. 1, 我们发现FCB(第3.1条)和BCB(第3.2条)都有助于它们的整体业绩,随着FLOPs的减少,它们的组合变得更加有效. 这些结果有助于突出减重标准本身的效力。 此外,这种设置的统一形状适合图形编译器,如JAX [28]中的XLA、NVIDIA的TensorRT [73]和火炬等。 编译 [5],将内核专用于静态外形,允许在等同块之间共享. 然而,由于统一削减战略,以前工作中的许多方法表现很差。 事实上,许多以前的工作(往往是非统一)预算分配战略有时被列为主要贡献(例如,[4、100、65、57、102、63、113])。

blocks.en: Tab. 2 addresses this by exploring different FLOPs budget allocation strategies. Some methods focus their FLOPs reduction entirely in the LLM ( e.g . , [ 64 , 33 , 25 , 113 ] ), resulting in higher pruning per-layer to reach FLOPs budgets that we found can quickly collapse performance. This could be seen as unfair since other methods may compress both towers. However, we found prior work often did not generalize beyond their original tower scope as demonstrated by the poor performance of methods like PruneLLM [ 113 ] in Tab. 1 and is also echoed in prior work [ 95 ] .
blocks.zh: 标签2通过探索不同的财务业务方案预算分配战略来解决这一问题。 一些方法将其FLOP的削减完全集中在LLM中(例如,[64,33,25,113]),导致更高水平的每层的挤压达到FLOP的预算,我们发现这些预算可以迅速崩溃. 这可被视为不公平,因为其他方法可能会将两座塔都压缩. 然而,我们发现先前的工作往往没有超出其最初的塔形范围而泛泛而论,塔克语中PruneLLM[113]等方法的不良性能就证明了这一点. 1,在前作中也有回放. [95].

blocks.en: That said, some methods like AdaSVD [ 57 ] proposed a search strategy that Tab. 2 shows works well factorizing both ViT and LLM towers. For our own BTWF approach that also factorizes both towers, we add extra model capacity without adding test latency via OG ( Sec. 3.3.1 ), and use uniform WF for other layers. Comparing the results from prior work in Tab. 2 to their corresponding uniform strategy results from Tab. 1 shows methods improved up to 7%. However, Tab. 2 also reports our approach still outperforms them by 3-6% overall. Further, many methods we evaluated also create non-uniform block shapes ( e.g . , [ 57 ] ), unlike our approach that still creates uniform sizes that is easily optimized as discussed earlier. See Appendix B for further discussion on OG’s effect on training.

blocks.en: Tab. 3 reports performance after a recovery stage where we finetuned all damaged layers using the Seen datasets to help heal affected layers. Comparing these results to those in the prior two tables, performance jumped up to 41% across the pruning rates. BTWF also reports gains after recovery of 1-3.5% over prior work. However, the benefit from recovery was mostly on Seen datasets, with boosts to Unseen datasets being far smaller. See Appendix C for a longer discussion on recovery strategies.

blocks.en: Finally, Tab. 4 compares BTWF to closely related factorization methods over five additional architectures. Our approach gets the best performance in the vast majority of settings, including reporting gains in at least two of three FLOPs budgets for every model (and is the second best otherwise), demonstrating its ability to generalize.

blocks.en: Effect of sharing a basis between layers of different size. In Sec. 3.1 we claimed that using WF methods of prior work over shared layers of unequal sizes (like the twin layers that both Cat [ 63 ] and we use) would likely bias the fit towards the larger layer. Tab. 5 demonstrates this occurs in practice by comparing the relative activation-space reconstruction error over the same layers. We find balancing member contribution can help overall reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 不同大小的地层之间共享基础的效果. 在第3.1节中,我们声称,用WF方法在大小不均的共享地层上(如Cat[63]和我们使用的双层)以前工作,可能会将合身性偏向更大的地层。 Tab. 5通过比较同一层的相对活化-空间重建出错来证明这在实践中发生. 我们认为,平衡成员的贡献有助于整体重建。

In other words, that some bias might actually be beneficial rather than purely even balancing ( i.e . , γ ≠ 1 \gamma\neq 1 in Eq. 4 ). blocks.en: Effect of BCB on selected factors. Fig. 3 compares the reconstruction quality of BTWF with and without BCB. In layers 15–27, BCB increases the shared members’ reconstruction error by 8–10%, yet decreases the error of the block output on image tokens by 15–17%. The effect grows with depth, e.g . , the final layer’s output error falls by about 40%, while layers 0–14 change by only 2–3%.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: This paper introduced Balanced Twin Weight Factorization (BTWF), a shared-basis WF method that computes a single basis once for each group of twin layers, so more of the FLOPs it removes translate into lower latency. BTWF uses FCB to remove a bias suffered by prior work in favor of larger group members, and BCB keeps factors that matter most for each block’s output. Further, we show OG can add capacity to rank-sensitive layers during training, which are folded back to their dense size for inference at no extra cost. Across six MLLMs and nine image and video benchmarks, BTWF outperforms the state of the art by 2-6% without finetuning and by 1-3.5% after recovery at matched FLOPs, while being the fastest of the factorization methods we evaluated. When used as a drop-in replacement, BTWF also improves combinations with weight pruning, quantization, and token pruning by 1-9%. Future work could explore mechanisms to leverage more of the OG capacity, or more fully explore combinations with related tasks for further gains.

BTWF利用FCB来去除先前工作给较大集团成员带来的偏见,BCB对每个块的产出都保留着最重要的因素. 此外,我们显示,在训练期间,OG可以增加军衔敏感层的能力,这些层可以折回到密集的体积,无需额外成本推论. 在6个MLLM和9个图像和视频基准中,BTWF在没有微调的情况下比技术水平高了2-6%,在相应的FLOP恢复后比1-3.5%,同时是我们评估的指数化方法中最快的。 BTWF在被用做倒置取而代之时,也会将配重回放,分量回放,和活物回放等组合改进为1-9%. 今后的工作可以探索机制来利用更多的管理小组能力,或者更充分地探索与相关任务相结合,以进一步取得成果。

blocks.en: FWSVD [ 41 ] . This method weights each output row of a matrix by its Fisher information, i.e . , the summed squared gradients of the task loss with respect to that row’s weights, before the SVD. Thus, rows the loss is more sensitive to are reconstructed more accurately, trading a worse weight reconstruction for task accuracy closer to the original model. Implementation details: gradients are taken per sample on the dense model with our calibration language-modeling loss over the 256 CLEVRER calibration samples. Each member’s weights are normalized to unit mean square, so they only redistribute rank within a member and BCB sets the balance between members.
blocks.zh: FWSVD [41] (英语). 这种方法用其Fisher信息对矩阵的每个输出行进行加权,即在SVD之前,该行重量方面任务损失的总和平方梯度。 这样一来,行所损失的灵敏度更能被更精确地重建,用更差的重量重建来换取更接近原始模型的任务精度. 实施细节:在密集模型上每个样本取出梯度,与256 CLEVRER校正样本相比,我们的校正语言模型丢失. 每个成员的权重都归一为单位平均平方,因此它们只在一个成员内部重新分配级别,而BCB在成员之间设置了平衡.

blocks.en: MoDeGPT [ 60 ] . This approach compresses pairs of consecutive matrices so that their joint output is preserved, using a Nyström approximation that keeps MLP channels with the highest ridge leverage scores of the intermediate activations, a CR decomposition that keeps query/key dimensions with the largest product of query and key activation norms, and an SVD of the activation-weighted value/output product. Implementation details: we use MoDeGPT’s selection scores as the row weights δ \delta in Eq. 5 , with each row’s squared weight proportional to its score. Gate and up rows share the ridge leverage of their channel ( λ = 1 \lambda{=}1 , as in their paper), query rows use the per-dimension query/key norm product, and key rows use the paper’s grouped-query group score. The value/output SVD has no per-row score, so value rows are weighted by the norm of the output-projection columns they feed, which is similar to BCB’s value weight. In addition, as with BCB, the rotated query/key pairs share their second moments, and each member is normalized to unit mean square.
blocks.zh: MoDEGPT [60] (英语). 这种方法压缩了相接基团的对子,使其联合输出得以保存,使用Nyström近似能使MLP通道保持中间活化中最高的脊杠杆分数,CR分解能使查询/键维能保持查询和键活化规范的最大出产,活化加权值/出产的SVD. 执行细节:我们使用MODEGPT的选取分数作为 Eq. 5 中的 \ delta 分数,每行的平方分分数与其分数成正比。 出入口和上行共享其信道的山脊杠杆(QQ = 1\lambda{=}1,如出一纸),查询行使用平分查询/按键规范产品,而关键行则使用纸张的分组-克来组分. 值/输出 SVD 没有每行分数,因此值行被它们输入的输出-投影列的规范加权,这与BCB的值重相类似. 此外,同BCB一样,旋转的查询/键对分享了它们的第二个瞬间,每个成员被正常化为单位平均平方.

blocks.en: Tab. 11 replaces BCB’s row weights with those of FWSVD [ 41 ] and MoDeGPT [ 60 ] , keeping every other part of BTWF fixed. BCB obtains the best overall result at every budget, with the clearest gain at 30% where it reports a 1-2% gain overall. Notably, neither alternative consistently improves over using no row weights at all. FWSVD lowers All at 10% and 30% and raises it only at 50%, which suggests that the gradient of a calibration language-modeling loss is a noisy guide to which rows matter. MoDeGPT’s ridge leverage on gate/up members measures how much a channel contributes to the span of the intermediate activations, while BCB also accounts for how strongly the channel reaches the block output through the down projection and the gate. Overall, these results suggest block-output sensitivity is a more useful signal than similar local measures (MoDeGPT) or a focus on the final output (FWSVD).
blocks.zh: 标签11用FWSVD[41]和MODEGPT[60]来取代BCB的行重,使BTWF的所有其他部分保持固定. BCB在每个预算中都取得了最佳的总体结果,最明显的收益为30%,而它报告的总收益为1-2%。 值得注意的是,这两种选择都无法持续地改进使用任何行重。 FWSVD 下调 全部为10%和30%,只提升到50%,这表明校正语言模型丢失的梯度是一个响亮的向导,哪一行才重要. MoDeGPT在门/上成员上的脊杠杆测量一个信道对中间激活的跨度贡献多少,而BCB也说明该信道通过下行投影和闸门到达块输出的强度. 总体而言,这些结果表明,阻断-输出敏感性是一个比类似的局部度量(MoDeGPT)更有用的信号,或者是对最终输出(FWSVD)的关注.

blocks.en: OG makes two notable changes when it is applied. First, it keeps the chosen groups at dense cost, which forces the rest of the model to be compressed harder to meet the same budget. Second, groups where μ > μ ∗ \mu>\mu^{\ast} have more factor ranks than they need to represent their dense layers. To separate the two, Fig. 4 compares the vision MLP at μ = μ ∗ = 1.25 \mu{=}\mu^{\ast}{=}1.25 and μ = 1.5 \mu{=}1.5 against no OG at the 30% and 50% budgets. At μ ∗ \mu^{\ast} the factors can represent the dense layers exactly but have no spare rank. Thus, the two OG variants share the same inference FLOPs, the same compression rate of every other layer, and the same model before recovery (their no-recovery accuracy agrees within 0.5%). Therefore, any difference after recovery comes from the extra rank directions that are trained like the remaining factors.

blocks.en: Fig. 4 shows that keeping the vision MLP at dense cost accounts for some of the drop in training loss. In the third epoch, μ = 1.25 \mu{=}1.25 lowers the loss from 0.089 to 0.082 at 30% and from 0.132 to 0.117 at 50%, and the gap is already present in the first epoch (0.190 vs. 0.178 and 0.244 vs. 0.229). Since the function class of the two variants is identical, the extra rank changes how the factors are optimized rather than what they can represent. This is consistent with the implicit acceleration observed when linear layers are overparameterized as products of factors [ 7 ] . The extra directions also stay small: after recovery, their rank-one terms ‖ u i ‖ ​ ‖ v i ‖ \|u_{i}\|\|v_{i}\| are about 1–2% of the largest direction. Future work could alter the recovery strategy to make better use of these new factors.

blocks.en: C.1 Results
blocks.zh: C.1 结果

blocks.en: Table 12 reports performance over varying recovery strategies evaluated using 500 samples from each dataset. In the top section we find that BTWF is largely insensitive to how it is recovered, with simple SFT being within 1.5 points of the best strategy at every budget. Training only the last three LLM blocks is the exception, but is likely due to the fact that compression error is spread across every block of both towers. Thus, the last few blocks cannot correct it.
blocks.zh: 表12报告利用每个数据集的500个样本评价的不同回收战略的执行情况。 在顶部部分,我们发现BTWF对如何回收基本上不敏感,简单的SFT在每个预算的最佳战略1.5分之内. 训练只有最后三个LLM区块是例外,但很可能是由于压缩出错被分散在两个塔的每个区块. 因此,最后几个街区无法纠正。

blocks.en: In Table 12 (middle) PORTA [ 49 ] behaves differently, with swings in overall performance up to 29% (compared to BTWF’s largest overall swing of 13%). Even SFT itself is up to 14% off of the best method. Further, the best recovery method changes across pruning rates, e.g . , LoRA is the best at 30%, but second worst at 10% and 50%. Variance due to random seed is also generally higher than BTWF, with the highest being LoRA at 50% (std of 8.1, whereas BTWF’s highest is 2.8). Thus, selecting the correct strategy for the pruning rate makes a significant difference for weight pruning methods like PORTA, whereas BTWF provides more stable and often better results.
blocks.zh: 在表12(中)中,波尔塔[49]的表现不同,总体业绩波动高达29%(而BTWF最大的总体波动为13%)。 即使是SFT本身也高达14%的最好方法. 此外,最佳的回收方法会改变整个回收率,例如,LORA是最好的30%,但最低的是10%和50%。 随机种子造成的差异一般也高于BTWF,最高的是LORA,为50%(8.1分之一,而BTWF最高为2.8分之一)。 因此,选择正确的径流速率策略对波尔塔等重力径流方法有很大不同,而BTWF则提供更稳定且往往更好的效果.

blocks.en: Finally, running each source method end to end ( Table 12 (bottom)) is worse than recovering a BTWF or PORTA model at every budget. Thus, we can conclude that recovery benefits may vary, with some methods being more sensitive than others (ours being less so). However, we argue our comparisons are fair to prior work as the combination of a particular method’s pruning and recovery combination does not outperform us.

blocks.en:
Measurement setup. All models run on a single NVIDIA L40S GPU in bfloat16 with a batch size of 1.
We evaluate latency and memory on each model on the first 500 test samples of each dataset (4,500 in total), using the same preprocessing and prompts as our task evaluation. However, reported task performance uses the full test set from the main results. Each request generates exactly 16 tokens so answer length does not affect latency.
We report the mean end-to-end time per sample, covering the vision encoder, prefill and decoding, but excluding preprocessing, compilation and warm-up.
Repeated runs of the same model differ by at most 4%.
Memory is the peak GPU memory (weights, key/value cache and activations) needed to answer the largest test sample, which is the same in every run.
blocks.zh:
测量设置. 所有型号都运行在bfloat16的单NVIDIA L40S GPU上,分批大小为1.
我们利用与我们任务评价相同的预处理和提示,评估每个数据集前500个测试样本(共4 500个)上每个模型的耐久性和内存。 然而,报告的任务业绩采用主要结果的全套测试。 每个请求都产生16个符号,所以答案长度不影响时间。

blocks.en:
Deployment. For a fair comparison, every method, including the dense model, is deployed in the same optimized form.
Linear layers that share an input (the query/key/value and the gate/up projections) run as a single matrix multiplication, and shared-basis methods (Cat and BTWF) compute each shared basis z = B ​ x z=Bx once for all of its twin members (see Fig. 2 ).
OG factors are folded back to their dense size before deployment (described in Sec. 3.3.1 ).
Further, any factorized layer we measure slower than its dense form is also folded back into a single matrix. A layer’s widths and ranks that are not a multiple of 8 are zero-padded, which does not affect the model’s outputs beyond bfloat16 rounding.
Skip connections (Cat w/ Skip and BTWF & Skip) are folded into the input factor, which gives the same outputs and we found to be faster than applying them as a separate addition.
Finally, all models use a preallocated key/value cache, are compiled with torch.compile , and replay each decoding step as a CUDA graph.
The only exception is the prefill of Qwen3.5-2B, whose linear-attention kernels do not compile, so it runs uncompiled for every Qwen3.5-2B model, including the dense one.

跳过连接 (Cat w/ Skip和BTWF & Skip)被折叠到输入因子中,这个因子给出了相同的输出,我们发现比将它们作为单独的添加应用要快.
最后,所有模型都使用预先分配的密钥/值缓存,用火炬来编译. 编译,并重放每个解码步骤作为CUDA图.
唯一的例外是预填出Quen3.5-2B,其线性注心内核不编译,因此它运行的每个Quen3.5-2B模型,包括稠密的.

blocks.en: Tab. 13 reports the latency and memory costs across architectures to augment the method-focused evaluation in Tab. 10 of the main paper. Generally speaking, our method gets the highest performance with the lowest latencies between all the WF methods in our comparisons. Basis Sharing [ 102 ] sometimes requires a little less memory, but comes at significant loss in task accuracy that can be more than made up by reducing the FLOPs budget. For example, both InternVL3 models have 30% FLOPs Basis Sharing accuracies that match BTWF at 50%, but where ours has much lower latencies at that budget. Further, Tab. 13 shows the factorized models at 50% are 1.08–1.35 × \times faster than the dense model and use 18–43% less memory, demonstrating that the computational gains can be reached in practice. That said, they do not achieve the 50% speedup their FLOPs budget would suggest, highlighting a need for better support for these types of methods to obtain their full benefits.
blocks.zh: 附表13报告了各个架构的延迟性和内存成本,以加强 Tab 中注重方法的评价。 主报十. 一般来说,我们的方法在比较中得到了最高的性能,所有WF方法之间的延迟最少. 基础共享[102]有时需要的内存要少一点,但任务准确性却受到重大损失,而通过减少FLOPs的预算,任务准确性可以超过弥补. 例如,两个InternVL3模型都有30%的FLOPs基础共享速率,与BTWF相匹配为50%,但我们的预算延迟率要低得多。 此外,Tab.13显示,50%的因子化模型比密集模型快1.08–1.35 —\时间,并使用18–43 %的内存,表明计算收益在实践中可以实现。 尽管如此,它们并没有实现50%的速率,因此它们认为需要更好地支持这些类型的方法,以获得其全部利益。

blocks.en: Datasets differ greatly in their sensitivity to compression. Open-ended image question answering (TextVQA, VizWiz, VQAv2, GQA) degrades the fastest across tables, with TextVQA being the most sensitive, which requires reading fine-grained text in the image. In Tab. 14 , TextVQA falls up to 8% for the best methods, whereas Perception Test only loses 2.5% for BTWF after 20% additional compression. Although multiple-choice video benchmarks may appear to degrade more slowly, this is due, in part, to the fact that they also have a chance floor (33.3% for Perception Test and 20% for NExT-QA). Without recovery, many methods sit near that floor at the 50% budget (see Tab. 17 ). Thus, many of the differences without recovery in All at the highest FLOPs rates come mostly from the open-ended datasets.
blocks.zh: 数据集对压缩的敏感度相差很大. 开放式图像问题回答(TextVQA,VizWiz,VQAv2,GQA)对表格的降解速度最快,而TextVQA是最敏感的,这需要在图像中读取精细的文字. 在 Tab. 14中,TextVQA 对于最佳方法跌至8%,而Perception Test在额外压缩20%后,BTWF只损失2.5%. 虽然多选择的视频基准似乎下降得比较慢,但部分原因是它们也有机会底线(感知测试为33.3%,NExT-QA为20%)。 没有恢复,许多方法就接近50%的预算。 因此,许多没有以最高速率回收的差别大多来自开放式数据集。

blocks.en: Budget allocation. We found that methods that keep the whole vision tower intact helps at low compression. For example, at 10% SlimLLM is the best method on VizWiz, VideoMME, and LongVideoBench, even though it is 3% lower on All ( Tab. 15 ). The same choice breaks down at 30%, where removing 30% of the model’s FLOPs from the LLM alone collapses most LLM-only methods.

blocks.en: Recovery. Tab. 16 shows most of the Seen gain from recovery comes from CLEVRER. This is due, in part, to the poor performance from the base model itself ( Tab. 23 reports a 45% gain from SFT on the dense model). In fact, the dense model loses accuracy on some datasets after SFT ( e.g . , TextVQA, VQAv2, VideoMME). In contrast, at 50% FLOPs recovery significantly helps Unseen VQAv2 accuracy, whose questions resemble GQA’s from the recovery mix, while TextVQA gets a much smaller gain. This suggests that recovery restores skills Seen datasets exercise but not skills they lack, such as reading text. The source methods in Tab. 16 (a) show the same trade-off.
blocks.zh: 复苏。 Tab. 16显示Seen从恢复中获取的大部分收益来自CLEVRER. 部分原因是基础模型本身的性能不佳(附件23报告SFT在密集模型上获得了45%的收益)。 事实上,稠密的模型在SFT后会失去一些数据集的精度(例如:TextVQA,VQAv2,VideoMME). 反之,FLOPs的回收率高达50%,极大地帮助了Unseen VQAv2的准确性,其问题与回收组合中的GQA类似,而TextVQA得到的收益要小得多. 这说明恢复会恢复技能 已看到数据集的练习,但不是它们缺乏的技能,比如读取文本. Tab.16(a)中的源方法也显示出同样的取舍.

blocks.en: Common protocol. Unless noted, every baseline is calibrated on the same 256 CLEVRER [ 115 ] samples as BTWF and is applied to every block linear of both the vision and language towers. Each method’s own compression knob is solved so that the whole model meets the same FLOPs budget Ω f \Omega_{f} ( Sec. 3.3 ). Only the criterion that chooses which heads and channels to remove differs between methods. In Tab. 2 and Tab. 3 (a), methods use their own allocation. For example, a LLM pruning method will keep the ViT dense. For unstructured pruning methods [ 91 , 49 , 110 , 125 ] , we apply their criteria to whole channels and heads rather than per-weight unless otherwise noted.

blocks.zh: 普特丽 [17]. 以平方活化规范来去除MLP通道,并用最小平方通过网络来相接输出投影. 注意头在被打消后,会按照迷惑性增加排序. 执行细节:载于Tab。 1 头部的模糊度每头计算一次(16个校正序列),并在每层内排名,取代了纸上迭代的全球贪婪搜索(720名候选人买不起),而头部单位是一个单一的查询头. 在塔布语. 2,我们运行了本文全球贪婪地删除分组头部(每个迭代两个)及其人头统计规则. 50%的预算不可行,因为每层要求的分组头数超过一个。

blocks.zh: 万达 [91] + Putri [17]. 使用万达选择通道和头部以及普特里最小平方的再造,

blocks.en: AMP [ 71 ] . Scores heads by the ℓ 1 \ell_{1} norm of their projected output, ‖ h n ​ W n ‖ 1 \|h_{n}W_{n}\|_{1} , and MLP neurons by activation magnitude, then removes the same fraction of each per layer, followed by LoRA (rank 8, learning rate 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , 2 epochs). Implementation details: under GQA attention [ 1 ] , heads are removed in KV-group pairs and the channel fraction absorbs the rounding to meet the FLOPs budget.

blocks.en: PruneLLM [ 113 ] . Scores channels by information entropy, selects them with K-means clustering, and allocates sparsity across blocks, sub-layers, KV groups and channels by transfer entropy. Bias compensation uses the signed calibration mean, and no fine-tuning follows.
blocks.zh: PruneLLM [113] (英语). 以信息 en为分数通道,用克-指集群来选择它们,再通过传输 en来分出区块,子层,克V组和通道. Bias补偿使用所签名的校正平均值,没有进行微调。

blocks.en: D 2 Prune [ 110 ] . Scores weights with a dual-Taylor expansion over both input and output activations plus an OBS term from SparseGPT [ 26 ] to estimate reconstruction error. Implementation details: we use the paper’s default hyperparameters ( λ 1 = 1 \lambda_{1}{=}1 , λ 2 = 0 \lambda_{2}{=}0 , s = 1500 s{=}1500 ) to apply the OBS update sequentially by layer.
blocks.zh: D 2 普鲁纳 [110]. 在输入和输出活化上加上SparseGPT [26] 的 OBS术语以双Taylor扩展的分数来估计重建出错. 执行细节:我们使用纸的默认超参数(λ 1 = 1\lambda_{1}{=}1,λ 2 = 0\lambda_{2}{=}0, s = 1500 s{=}1500)依次逐层应用 OBS 更新.

blocks.en: SVD-LLM [ 105 ] . This WF method uses truncation-aware whitening where each matrix selects factors in the Cholesky-whitened space, W ≈ ( W ​ L ) r ​ L − 1 W\approx(WL)_{r}L^{-1} (more details in Sec. 3.1 ). Implementation details: in Tab. 1 , Tab. 4 and Tab. 3 (b) every block linear of both towers is factorized, and the closed-form layer-wise update of the preprint is applied at ratios of 40% and above (our 50% budget only). In Tab. 2 and Tab. 3 (a) we follow their published work: language model only, no update without recovery (its SVD-LLM (W) ablation), and its sequential low-rank update (LoRA on U U with V V frozen, then on V V ) as recovery.
blocks.zh: SVD-LLM [105] (英语). 这种WF方法使用短发-发觉白化法,其中每个矩阵在Cholesky-白化空间中选择因子,W Q (W L) r L - 1 W\近似(WL) {}L}}}(详见第3.1节)。 实施细节:在"分册一","分册四"和"分册三"(b)中,将两座塔的每块线性都归为因地制宜,预印版的封闭式分层更新应用在40%及以上的比例上(只有50%的预算). 在Tab. 2和Tab. 3(a)中,我们遵循他们出版的作品:只有语言模型,没有恢复就没有更新(its SVD-LLM (W) blation),并且其相继的低级更新(LORA on U U with V V V 被冻结,然后在 V V V 上)作为恢复.

blocks.en: Basis Sharing [ 102 ] . Shares one whitened low-rank basis across a pair of consecutive layers, with per-layer coefficients, plus SVD-LLM’s update at ratios of 40% and above. Implementation details: only gate/up are shared across layer pairs because sharing q/k/v increased activation error 2–3 × \times . Layers 0–1 are not shared because their Gram traces differ by 21.6 × \times . After the joint fit, each member’s coefficients are re-solved against its own Gram, and the update uses a 10 − 4 10^{-4} relative ridge instead of a plain inverse. The vision tower is factorized but not shared.
blocks.zh: 基础共享[102]. 在一对连续的地层中共享一个白色的低等基数,每层系数,加上SVD-LLM的更新比例为40%及以上. 执行细节:由于共享 q/k/v 增加了活化出错 2–3 ×\times ,所以只共享出门/上层对. 0–1层不共享,因为其Gram痕迹相差21.6×\times. 联合合肥后,每个成员的系数会根据自己的格拉姆重解,更新时使用的是10-4 10-QQ-4}相对的山脊而不是平地倒数. 视塔被分化了,但没有共享.

blocks.en: LLM-Pruner [ 64 ] . Removes coupled structure groups (heads, MLP channels) ranked by first-order plus Fisher Taylor importance, summed over each group. Implementation details: it keeps the first three blocks and the last block dense, applies a uniform ratio to the rest, and recovers with LoRA (rank 8, α = 16 \alpha{=}16 , dropout 0.05, learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , 2 epochs). Heads are rounded to KV-group pairs and the channel count is solved to meet the FLOPs budget.
blocks.zh: LLM-Pruner [64] (英语). 删除组合结构组(头, MLP 频道),按一等分顺序排列,加上Fisher Taylor的重要性,概括到每个组。 执行细节:它保持了前三个街区和后一个街区的密度,对其余街区实行统一的比例,并与LORA(排名8,α=16\alpha{=}16,辍学率为0.05,学习率为10−4 10^{-4},2个纪元)恢复. 头被四舍五入为KV组对并解决了频道计数以满足FLOPs的预算.

blocks.en: SlimLLM [ 33 ] . Selects heads by a Pearson-correlation score with a greedy swap, and channels by a score in the principal-component basis of the centred output. It sets per-layer ratios with its Eq. 11, skipping the first and last layers, refits o_proj and down_proj by per-output linear regression, and recovers with LLM-Pruner’s LoRA. Implementation details: the mean ratio is bisected to meet the FLOPs budget. α \alpha is interpolated between the paper’s two stated points (10 at 20%, 7 at 50%). Head selection respects GQA attention groups.
blocks.zh: SlimLLM [33] (英语). 以贪婪的互换方式选择皮尔逊-血缘关系得分,以中心输出的主成份基础选择得分的渠道. 它用Eq. 11设定了每层比率,跳过了第一层和最后一层,通过每输出线性回归来调整 o_proj 和下-proj , 用 LLM-Pruner 的 LORA 恢复。 执行详情:平均比率为两相取舍,以达到《前线方案》的预算。 α-alpha被插入报社的两个声明点(10分20%,7分50%)之间. 头部选择尊重GQA关注组.

blocks.en: AdaSVD [ 57 ] . Extends SVD-LLM with adaComp, which alternately re-solves U U and V V by pseudo-inverse against the deviated inputs (one iteration), and adaCR, which sets per-block retention from block importance (span 0.1). Implementation details: we use the exact Gram over all calibration samples rather than the paper’s stack-of-batch approximation. Block importance is 1 − cos ⁡ ( block input , block output ) 1-\cos(\text{block input},\text{block output}) as in their paper’s Fig. 3 and is normalized per tower. The retention ratio is bisected to the FLOPs budget, and the ViT is also compressed.
blocks.zh: AdaSVD [57] (英语). 将 SVD-LLM 扩展为 adaComp , 它通过假反向重解 U U 和 V V 与偏移输入(一次迭接) , 以及 adaCR , 将每个区块保留在区块重要性( span 0.1) 。 执行细节:我们用精确的格拉姆来校准所有标本,而不是纸上堆放的相近图. 块重要性为 1 - cos (块输入, 块输出) 1-\cos (\text{block 输入},\text{block 输出}) , 和他们的纸张图中的数字 3 一样, 每个塔都正常 。 保留比例与FLOPs预算相分出,而VIT也被压缩.

blocks.en: Cat [ 63 ] . Uses the same shared-input WF for twin layers as our work (both our work and theirs will still factorize singletons). Cat w/Skip additionally writes every input factor in block-skip form V 1 ​ [ I | V 1 − 1 ​ V 2 ] ​ P ⊤ V_{1}[I\;|\;V_{1}^{-1}V_{2}]P^{\top} , solving rank against the r ⁡ ( n + m − r ) r(n{+}m{-}r) cost. Columns are chosen by maxvol (entries of | V 1 − 1 ​ V 2 | ≤ 1.05 |V_{1}^{-1}V_{2}|\leq 1.05 ). Combining with BTWF: Skip changes only how each factor is stored, so it composes directly with our factorization. We fit the factors with BTWF, then rewrite every input factor, shared or not, in the same block-skip form with the same maxvol column selection, and solve the per-layer rank against the block-skip cost so the FLOPs budget is met exactly.

Minitron [ 72 ] . Ranks heads and MLP neurons by activation importance alone: the mean over samples of each sample’s token-wise ℓ 2 \ell_{2} norm. Recovery is pure logit distillation from the dense model ( α = 1 \alpha{=}1 , T = 1 T{=}1 , full fine-tune).
blocks.zh: 米尼特龙 [72]. 单通过激活重要性来排出头和MLP神经元:每个样本的标注值的平均值I 2\ell\2}规范。 回收是从稠密模型(α = 1\alpha{=}1,T = 1 T{=}1,全微调)得到的纯对数分馏.

blocks.en: RLP [ 62 ] . A recovery method that drops the last blocks and then fine-tunes only the lm_head and the last three remaining language-model blocks.
blocks.zh: RLP [62] (英语). 一种回收方法,将上个区块放下,然后只微调lm_head和后三个剩余的语言模型区块.

blocks.en: INTERLACE [ 65 ] . Walks the network in non-overlapping triplets of consecutive layers. In each, it drops the more locally redundant of the first two ( 1 − cos 1-\cos of block input and output), fine-tunes the survivor, and freezes the third as an anchor. The 50% FLOPs budget is infeasible since removing one layer per triplet caps the reduction.
blocks.zh: 内地 [65]. 以连续三层不相重叠的方式走过网络。 在每种情况下,它都会减少前两个中比较本地冗余的(1-cos 1-\cos of block 输入和输出),对幸存者进行微调,并冻结第三个作为锚. 50%的FLOP预算是行不通的,因为每三胞胎减少一层。

blocks.en: Structured GMP [ 125 ] . Gradual magnitude pruning with a cubic sparsity schedule, starting from the dense model during fine-tuning. Implementation details: it uses 20 pruning steps over the first two-thirds of training.

blocks.en: TRSP [ 25 ] . Performs depth pruning with two regularization stages on the calibration set. First, a learnable scalar s i s_{i} scales each language-model layer, and the model is trained on its language-modeling loss plus λ 1 ​ ∑ i | s i | \lambda_{1}\sum_{i}|s_{i}| . After each pass the layer with the smallest | s i | |s_{i}| is masked until the target number of layers is selected. Second, with the selected layers active again, training adds λ 2 ​ ∑ i ∈ P ‖ X out i − X in i ‖ \lambda_{2}\sum_{i\in P}\|X^{i}_{\mathrm{out}}-X^{i}_{\mathrm{in}}\| , pushing those layers toward the identity so their knowledge moves to the kept layers before they are removed. Implementation details: we use the paper’s λ 1 = 5 × 10 − 3 \lambda_{1}{=}5{\times}10^{-3} , λ 2 = 10 − 3 \lambda_{2}{=}10^{-3} and optimizer (AdamW, learning rate 2 × 10 − 5 2{\times}10^{-5} , all language-model weights trainable). Two changes were needed for the scalars to select layers in a pre-norm model. Specifically, when applied to the full layer output, as in the paper, the scalars barely moved from their initialization at the paper’s learning rate. Additionally, they selected the first and last layers, because scaling the residual stream is largely undone by the following normalization. Thus, we apply s i s_{i} to the residual branch, X out i = X in i + s i ​ f i ​ ( X in i ) X^{i}_{\mathrm{out}}=X^{i}_{\mathrm{in}}+s_{i}f_{i}(X^{i}_{\mathrm{in}}) , so s i = 0 s_{i}{=}0 is exactly the removed layer, and train the scalars with a learning rate of 10 − 2 10^{-2} (the weights keep 2 × 10 − 5 2{\times}10^{-5} ). For InternVL3-2B [ 124 ] , we remove the closest whole-layer match for the 10%/30%/50% FLOPs budgets, resulting in 3/10/16 of the 28 layers removed.

blocks.en: DDP [ 43 ] . In this work the pretrained weights are frozen and only a real-valued gate m k = ReLU ⁡ ( z k ) m_{k}=\mathrm{ReLU}(z_{k}) on every attention head and MLP channel is trained. A deterministic retention surrogate that is sharpened over training ( μ t \mu_{t} annealed from 0.5 to 0.05) is used by an augmented-Lagrangian sparsity penalty and a binarization term. The loss is CE + 2 ​ KL +\,2\,\mathrm{KL} to the dense model, plus these terms. Implementation details: training uses the paper’s settings (AdamW, learning rate 2 × 10 − 2 2{\times}10^{-2} for the gates, global batch 16, warm-up then cosine decay). The global budget is enforced separately for each of the four module types (language-model and vision heads and channels), each at the shared placement’s keep ratio, so the FLOPs match the other rows exactly. The final kept set is the top gates of each type, with at least one unit per layer and an equal number of query heads per KV group under GQA. The remaining units are removed and the kept gates are folded into the output projections. Gates are trained on our SFT data with cached teacher logits. In our experiments some run’s learned gates removed two first-layer query heads that the model cannot function without (removing the same two heads from a healthy seed drops accuracy to near zero, and restoring either recovers most of it). Thus, we exclude the first language-model layer’s heads from gating and pruning and remove its planned heads from the other layers instead, which keeps the head count and FLOPs unchanged.

blocks.en: CoMP [ 107 ] . This method jointly removes MLP channels in both towers and visual tokens inside the language model, chosen greedily stage by stage. Channels are scored by a token-weighted Wanda criterion, ∥ W : , i ∥ 1 ( ∑ n ω n x n , i 2 ) 1 / 2 \|W_{:,i}\|_{1}\,(\sum_{n}\omega_{n}x_{n,i}^{2})^{1/2} , where ω n \omega_{n} is the attention token n n receives (maximum over heads, summed over queries), so tokens already pruned stop contributing. Implementation details: Tokens are dropped in a cascade after language-model blocks 8, 14 and 20 by the same attention score. Each stage applies one mode (5% of a tower’s MLP channels, or 15% of the kept tokens), and the next mode is the one with the lowest smoothed cost Δ ​ accuracy / Δ ​ FLOPs \Delta\text{accuracy}/\Delta\text{FLOPs } , with interval-weighted random exploration (the paper’s ρ = 0.2 \rho{=}0.2 , τ = 5 \tau{=}5 , λ 0 = 0.4 \lambda_{0}{=}0.4 , I max = 5 I_{\max}{=}5 ). The search runs until the FLOPs budget is reached, shrinking the final stage to land on it exactly, with at least 1/8 of the image tokens kept. Combining with BTWF: we keep CoMP’s token pruning and replace its weight pruning with our factorization. The token rule CoMP reaches (keep ratio, drop blocks and attention criterion) is applied to the dense model. Its FLOPs savings are charged first, and BTWF factorizes every linear layer of both towers to cover the rest of the budget. The activation statistics for the factorization are collected with the token cascade active, leaving out of each language-model layer’s statistics the image tokens already dropped before that block. Thus, the factors are fitted to the activations the token-pruned model actually processes.

blocks.en: CoMP w/NLL. Our extension of CoMP’s search with two changes. First, it adds a ViT attention-head mode (one head per stage, scored by the same token-weighted criterion on the head’s output-projection columns, at least two heads kept). We do not add language-model heads since removing even one query head per KV group from every block collapses accuracy under every head score we tried. Second, it scores each stage by the negative mean log-likelihood of the dense model’s own 16-token answers on the calibration samples, teacher-forced, instead of accuracy. Calibration accuracy falls close to zero during the search, after which accuracy differences between stages are mostly noise.

blocks.en: GETA [ 78 ] . This method performs structured pruning and quantization-aware training. Each layer gets a learnable weight quantizer (step d d , clip q m q_{m} and exponent t t , which together set its bit-width), and the QASSO optimizer trains in four stages. After warm-up, a projection stage lowers the allowed bit-width each period and projects d d into that range. Then the joint stage picks redundant channel and head groups by HESSO saliency each period and decays them to zero while their quantizers keep training. A cool-down step fixes each layer’s rounded bit-width. Implementation details: we follow the authors’ released code. The pruning groups are LLM MLP channels, one query head per KV group, ViT heads and ViT MLP channels, and groups are removed until the FLOPs budget is met rather than to a fixed group count. Every linear layer of both towers is quantized and ends at exactly 4 bits (embeddings, language-model head and projector stay in bf16). Combining with BTWF: We start from the calibration-only BTWF model and run QASSO with pruning disabled. Its warm-up and projection stages bring every factor to 4 bits, and the cool-down holds the rounded bit-widths for the rest of training. Each factor gets its own quantizer, and a shared input factor is quantized once for all the layers that use it.

blocks.en: UniQL [ 16 ] . Performs structured pruning and 4-bit quantization that serves several budgets from one model. First, channels and head dimensions are reordered by importance with exact, output-preserving transforms. For example, MLP channels use ridge leverage of their activations, query/key dimensions by their activation energy, and value/output projections by an activation-whitened SVD. Each layer’s pruning rate is set from its block influence, 1 − cos ⁡ ( input , output ) 1-\cos(\text{input},\text{output}) , through a softmax. A masked LoRA fine-tune samples one budget per step and masks what that budget removes, then the model is quantized with GPTQ (4 bits, groups of 128) and truncated to each budget. Implementation details: we follow the paper’s recipe (LoRA rank 8 on every linear layer of both towers, 5 epochs, learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} ). The shared rate scale is bisected so each budget meets its FLOPs target, and kept sizes are multiples of 8. Quantization covers the same layers as GETA.

blocks.en: Each model we use are (one of) the smallest in its architecture family. These are chosen deliberately as they reflect likely applications of this type of computational reduction work. For example, if we were to compress a 72B model by 50%, one could simply argue that you could use a 32B model from the same family for similar benefits instead. Further, our experiments with InternVL3-1B and InternVL3-2B show that two models of different sizes from the same family can behave very differently. For example, Fig. 5 shows the 1B variant was more sensitive to choice of γ \gamma than the 2B model. Thus, evaluating at different scales would not necessarily replicate our setting where few alternatives exist other than to use WF or methods like it. Further, compact models also may be deployed to edge devices, where reducing memory and latency is even more important. This leads us to focus on these smaller architectures, with the InternVL3 evaluation providing a snapshot of model family variations.
blocks.zh: 我们使用的每一个模型都是其建筑家族中最小的。 这些是有意选择的,因为它们反映了这类计算减少工作的可能应用。 例如,如果我们把72B模型压缩50%, 人们可以简单地说,你可以使用来自同一家庭的32B模型来获取类似的福利。 此外,我们与InternVL3-1B和InternVL3-2B的实验表明,来自同一家的两种大小不同的模型的行为可能非常不同. 例如,图5显示1B的变体比2B型更能敏感地选择了γ\gamma. 因此,在不同规模上进行评价不一定会复制我们的环境,即除了使用世界自然基金会或类似方法之外,没有其他选择。 此外,还可以在边缘设备上部署紧凑的模型,在边缘设备中,减少记忆和耐用性更为重要。 这导致我们专注于这些较小的建筑,其中InternVL3评价提供了家庭变化模型的快照.
